input.command:
O=/config/workspace/IronClaude/.dev/worktrees/ci-followup/.dev/research/upstream-merge-impact/remaining-cleanup-validation/implementation-evidence/02-root-plugin/task4-runtime-bounded/runs/missing-post-attempt-1/artifacts
R=/config/workspace/IronClaude/.dev/worktrees/ci-followup/.dev/research/upstream-merge-impact/remaining-cleanup-validation/implementation-evidence/02-root-plugin/task4-runtime-bounded/fixtures/project
mkdir "$O"
SHA=$(sha256sum "$R/spec.md" | cut -d' ' -f1); TS=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
cat > "$O/audit.log" <<EOF
{"wave": 0, "step": "0.1", "timestamp": "$TS", "outcome": "ok", "evidence_ref": null, "note": "explicit --mode post (rule 1); audit_repo_root=$R (git -C rev-parse); selected inputs: spec=$R/spec.md"}
{"wave": 0, "step": "0.2", "timestamp": "$TS", "outcome": "fail", "evidence_ref": "$R/spec.md", "note": "spec readable (sha256 $SHA). STOP: --mode post requires --diff, --commit-range, or --task-log; none supplied. Unsupplied files in the project (changes.patch, execution.log) were NOT substituted."}
EOF
cat > "$O/return-contract.yaml" <<EOF
{
  "contract_version": "1.8.0",
  "status": "failed",
  "stop_reason": "post-mode-missing-completed-work-input",
  "stop_message": "--mode post requires --diff, --commit-range, or --task-log (post-execution reflection has no completed work to audit). A --spec alone does not satisfy a post audit.",
  "mode": "post",
  "tier_reached": null,
  "audit_repo_root": "$R",
  "selected_inputs": {"spec": "$R/spec.md", "tasklist": null, "diff": null, "commit_range": null, "task_log": null},
  "input_sha256": {"tasklist": null, "spec": "$SHA"},
  "report_path": null,
  "audit_log_path": "$O/audit.log",
  "confidence_calibrated": null,
  "escalation_rule_matched": null,
  "deviation_count_by_class": {"authorized": 0, "necessary": 0, "drift": 0, "regression": 0},
  "citations_total": 0, "citations_dropped": 0, "evidence_validator_ran": false,
  "reviewer_cards": [], "adversarial_artifacts_dir": null, "merge_method": null, "adversarial_unavailable": false,
  "remediation_offered": false, "remediation_accepted": false,
  "remediation_task_path": null, "remediation_plan_path": null, "task_file_path": null, "handoff_memory_key": null,
  "promotion_action": "skipped", "promotion_skip_reason": "user-flag", "promotion_gate_passed": null,
  "agents_dispatched": [],
  "note": "Stopped-precondition refusal at Wave 0. No calibration, reviewers, adversarial merge or evidence gate ran, so this is not an audit verdict."
}
EOF
uv run --no-project python -c "import json,sys;json.load(open(sys.argv[1]));print('ok')" "$O/return-contract.yaml"; ls "$O"
